identity.canonicalName: Brightech Luna Drop 66" LED Arc Floor Lamp, Antiqued Brass

classification.verdict: Brand-designed, sold under its own name
classification.verdictNote: Brightech's own design. Urban Outfitters sells it through its marketplace, shipped by Brightech.
classification.summary: An original Brightech product, described by Brightech as the sister to its best-selling Luna lamp. No individual designer is credited. On Urban Outfitters it's a UO MRKT listing, meaning Brightech sells and ships it and UO takes a cut; the name is unchanged.

specs.label: Size
specs.value: 66 in H × 14.5 in W × 10 in D

specs.label: Base
specs.value: White marble, 10 in across, 1.25 in H

specs.label: Bulb
specs.value: LED bulb included, E26 socket. UO lists a 3-way 16W, 1600 lumen bulb; Brightech lists 9.5W, 800 lumens

specs.label: Warranty
specs.value: 5 years at brightech.com; UO lists 3 years

quality: A slim brass arc that drops a frosted glass globe, anchored by a real marble base. At 20 lb it's stable, and the glass gives a soft all-around glow rather than reading light.

Brightech sells direct-to-consumer and through big marketplaces, which keeps the price low. The listings disagree on which bulb comes in the box; Brightech's own page says 800 lumens (about a 60W bulb), so plan on a brighter bulb if this is your main light.

maker.name: Brightech
paragraphs: Brightech is a Los Angeles lighting company founded in 2013 by Ardy Zara. Its pitch is designer-looking lamps at mass-market prices, sold on its own site and through Amazon, Target, Home Depot and others.
It uses LED bulbs throughout and works with overseas factories rather than making lamps itself. Products are credited to the brand, not to individual designers.
